programme.desc: Newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious dancing sickness, leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: In a last effort at glory, having lost most of their best men in military actions, Japan employs suicide pilots - Kamikaze - men who willingly crash their planes into ships in order to destroy the American spirit. But the U.S. Navy and Marines are ready for them with their guns, and they fought heroically against the onslaught. And on Okinawa, Americans fight a major battle with the Japanese Army.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: By summer 1944, Germany has undeniably lost the battle of the USSR. After the Soviet victories at Moscow, Stalingrad, Kursk, and Leningrad, the Soviet Union, with its practically unlimited resources of manpower and matériel, begins to rapidly push the Germans back toward the German border. On 22 June 1944, Stalin launches Operation Bagration, named after a Russian hero of the Napoleonic Wars.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: In 2006, some of the very few Jewish survivors told their stories on camera. How does one get out of Auschwitz? How do you recover from this hell? How do you recall and recount the atrocities of the camp? And how can we pass on the memory of the Holocaust?

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: From Germany's dramatic invasion of Poland, France, and Russia, to the Battle of Britain, the key battles in Africa, and onto the attack of Pearl Harbour and the eventual defeat of the Nazi army in Stalingrad. This program focuses on all the major events of this period, and also pays particular attention to the war's final year and the gradual destruction of the German army.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The drug addicted dilettante who created the Luftwaffe. Goering was at Hitler's side from the ill-fated Beer Hall putsch of 1923 until the estrangement between the two in April 1945 when Hitler ordered Goering's arrest.

programme.title: Artillery: The Gods of War
programme.desc: Traditionally the artillery has been the major killer on the battlefield. The task of the infantry and cavalry have been to fix the enemy in place for the artillery to destroy them with massed fire. Traditionally the horse and foot artillery did the job with field guns and howitzers. The bulk of fire has been indirect as a result of advances in technology and man's understanding of ballistics.

programme.title: Einsatzgruppen: The Nazi Death Squads
programme.desc: Faced with the advancing Soviet troops, Nazi Germany decides to have the bodies of death camp victims dug up and burned in graves.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: Volume 3 - Why Hitler lost World War II: Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat Nazi Germany and examines Adolf Hitler's thirst for power and his bumbling military errors including letting the BEF escape at Dunkirk.
programme.sub-title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler: Volume 3 - Why Hitler Lost WWII

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: While Hitler faced frustrations on all fronts, and the Japanese were kept at bay by the Americans, despite heavy US casualties, the Allied leaders faced a new challenge. Although Churchill and Roosevelt had always been comfortable working together, the Russian leader Joseph Stalin had in the past been regarded more as a foe than a friend.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As winter gave way to spring the world watched and waited as the Allied forces prepared for Operation Overlord. Brave and daring, risking all, US General Dwight D Eisenhower took charge of the campaign to deliver the fight directly to Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: America's Greatest Generals
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.
programme.sub-title: Dwight D. Eisenhower, Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell

programme.title: Memories of a Nazi Camp
programme.desc: The Natzweiler-Struthof camp has been erased from historical memory and yet.. with one of the highest death rate, this Nazi camp saw the worst eXactions and scientific eXperiences of the history.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: The 20th century saw a deadly leap in technology. This episode explores mankind's most fearsome creations-chemical, atomic, robotic, and nuclear weapons. From banned gases to bombs that level cities, it's the story of ultimate destruction. Some were used, others were not-but all redefined the scale of warfare and the terrifying potential of future conflicts.

programme.title: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun
programme.desc: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun was first created in the late 1870's, and was easily the largest weapon of the time. Weighing in at 103,888 kg, the 100 Ton Gun had an length of 9.953 meters, and took a crew of 35 men, including 18 men just to handle the ammunition. The gun was originally offered to the Royal Navy, who deemed it too heavy for use. The Italian Regia Marina then took the gun into service.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction
programme.desc: Both sides utilized air power during the Vietnam War, but the United States ruled the skies. The American pilots often were the factors that turned the fortunes of battles by interrupting enemy supply lines and communications, as well as gathering reconnaissance information for the ground troops. Despite the overwhelming success, it didn't produce victory. Vietnam air tactics broke the prior mold.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: After the failure to take both Moscow and Leningrad, Hitler sets his sights on the oil fields in the Caucasus. If captured, the Red Army will lose 70-90% of all its oil resources. Therefore, the famous city on the Volga, Stalingrad, must be 'held at all costs.' The German General Staff thinks taking the city will be a matter of a few weeks, but events steadily turn against the Germans.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Amateur filmmakers in Normandy secretly documented daily life between 1939-1945, risking arrest under Nazi rule. Preserved for decades, their footage reveals war's darkest hours-shortages, fear, and ruins-yet also family bonds, joy, and hope. This documentary offers an extraordinary civilian perspective, intertwining anonymous lives with the unfolding tragedy and liberation of WWII.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: Tokyo's firebombing proved deadly-wood and paper homes made cities burn fast. The B-29 bomber and napalm upped the carnage. In Europe, USAAF and RAF bombed day and night. New tech like bunker busters and bouncing bombs made targets harder to hide. The bomber was now war's most fearsome force.

programme.title: Stalin's Executioners: The Katyn Massacre
programme.desc: This film tells for the first time the story of the Katyn massacre seen from both sides: That of the victims and that of the perpetrators. It reveals how this crime, attributed to the Nazis for 50 years, was in fact carried out by the Soviet secret police, the NKVD.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: When humans took to the skies, they brought war with them. This episode traces aerial combat from WWI dogfights to bombers, jets, and drones. Exploring how air power evolved into one of the deadliest forces in warfare, it highlights the relentless drive to fly faster, strike harder, and control the skies-forever changing the face of battle from above.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Beneath the waves lurks a stealthy war machine. Capable of carrying nuclear weapons, submarines play a key role in the defense of many countries around the world today. The earliest beginnings of submarines can be traced back to the time of Alexander the Great in 323 B.C. In 1776 American inventor David Bushnell designed and constructed the first military submarine.

programme.title: Fighter Aircraft: The Quest For Speed
programme.desc: The rare combination to power and grace lends high performance aircraft a fascination all their own. Hurdling through the atmosphere at extraordinary velocities they traverse oceans and continents, accomplishing in a few hours what journeys would cost in painful labor and time. Making these airplanes faster has been a long endeavor in fuel and technology. One element remains constant - pilots.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Falklands War
programme.desc: The Battle between the UK and Argentina over claims to the Falkland Islands systematically merged weapons technology of air, sea, and ground. A UK invasion yielded a bombardment of speed, weaponry and destruction.

programme.title: Baby Cages: The Denazification Of Hitler Youth
programme.desc: In a final insane attempt to turn the tide of the war, Hitler recruited from the Hitler Youth, enlisting children as young as 12 years old. Around 10,000 of these young fighters, who were both persecutors and victims, would be taken prisoner by the Americans. A re-education program started at Attichy Camp to steer them towards an attitude of tolerance and democracy. It was called 'Baby Cages'.

programme.title: The Night of the Long Knives: Hitler's Rise to Power
programme.desc: The Night of the Long Knives is considered the first act of horror committed by the Nazis. What happened in Germany, and in Hitler's rise to power, that led to this purge in 1934? Caught between the conservative tendency and the revolutionary aspirations that were dividing the country, the Chancellor had a choice. To calm the rumors of a military coup against him, Hitler sent a clear message.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: This program is a unique examination of the history of courage among American fighting men and of the Medal of Honor which was developed in tribute to that quality. We examine the American revolutionary times, the Civil War, the War of 1812, the Indian War, the Spanish-American War, the two world wars, and the Korean and Vietnam conflicts. The host of the film is John Daly.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: The Allied invasion of Normandy is detailed-from preparation to execution-courtesy of vintage footage from both sides. A great victory for the Allies.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: In spite of spring and rain our ground forces continue to push back the Chinese all along the Eighth Army's front...The 25th Infantry Division crosses the Han River and U.N. forces reach the 38th Parallel. The program includes two interviews: The first with Sergeant William Taylor who was a mortar squad leader with the 24th Division. The other is with Lieutenant Charles Wright of Oneonta, Alabama.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The United Nations Offensive Continues

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces
programme.desc: Hitler's fortress Europe begins to crumble with Nazi occupying forces fall back on every front. The US Army Air Force grows to become the biggest armada the world has ever seen, gaining the air superiority needed to ensure complete victory.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Melting pot extreme, when traditional American barbecue meets authentic ethnic grilling and it's happening across the United States and around the world. Cross-culture mashups, from California paella to a deli-inspired pork loin stuffed with pastrami and sauerkraut. Michelin-starred chef Josiah Citrin dazzles with aged, smoked-roasted duck at his restaurant, Charcoal Venice.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Fusion Q

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: We reinvent the cocktail party, with the power of live fire to take finger food over the top with rum and citrus-glazed jumbo shrimp grilled on sugarcane, "finger-burner" lamb chops from Spain and Smoked Nectarine Bellinis to keep conversation flowing. Sommelier Kristine Bocchino shares suggestions for three great wines to serve at the party.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Grill Top Cocktail Party

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Extending from California and the Pacific Northwest to Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Explosively flavored grilled meats with exotic herbs and spices, chilies and umami-rich fish and soy sauce are paired with healthy vegetables-barbecue as health food. Vietnamese and Thai influences make the ultimate street food. Steven visits Jenee Kim for grilled beef short ribs.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Pacific Rim

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Fish Hits the Fire. Steven walks you through the grilling process-from whole fish to fire-roasting shellfish. Singapore-spiced halibut grilled in banana leaves. Whole fish with Indonesian flavors by Rafael Lunetta, in Santa Monica. Alaskan salmon riffs on Russian coulibiac, with a stuffing of grilled onions, mushrooms, rice and smoke. Finally, grilling fresh oysters with Asian aromatics.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Fish Hits the Fire

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: The deep connection between wine and barbecue dates back millennia. In the Santa Ynez, grape vines are used as fuel and wine for marinades, sauces. Jidori-breed chicken breasts stuffed with ham and dry-aged cheese. Grilled flank steak with Pinot Noir mushroom sauce grilled. Chef John Cox from the Bear and Star restaurant smokes a whole bourbon-soaked wagyu strip loin.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wine Country Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: The perfect grilled steak, using a range of savvy grilling techniques. Leading off is a thick dry-brined New York strip with luscious anchovy crema. Tender lamb steaks come with herb-scented Moroccan Charmoula. In today's field trip chef Curtis Stone grills an 80 day-aged rib steak over a wood fire at Gwen Butcher Shop and Restaurant in L.A.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Steak and Beyond

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: A food tour of Tunisia's Sidi Bou Said with local chef Malek Labidi ends cooking Shakshuka in a beautiful garden overlooking the sea. Later we dive into the Medina in Tunis to watch women hand make couscous. In Istanbul, a shopping trip with local TV chef Refika Burgul, ends in the kitchen making Salt Cured Sea Bass plus the addictive Turkish beef and French fry favorite, Kochertme.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - A Taste Of Tunisia And Turkey

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's on the Spanish island of Mallorca, where an ancient olive grove tended by sheep is the magical setting for cooking a hunters stew over an open fire. Back home, Sara makes Seafood Gazpacho. On 'Ask Sara', she answers a viewer's questions about Lemons.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Olive Mallorca: A Wood Fired Feast

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Fish is on the menu when Sara joins Greek Chef Maria Loi harborside near Athens to cook lemony, crispy skinned Branzino along with Beet, Beans and Feta Salad and Lemon Potatoes. Then it's off to Athen's Central Market to buy Retsina at a famous tavern for a rooftop mezze party in the shadow of the Acropolis. Back at home, Sara uses canned sardines for a quick and easy pantry taco.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Under The Acropolis

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Chicken or eggs? Sara's got some amazing recipes to make them shine, starting with a chicken paillard, slathered in a compound date butter. Baked Chicken thighs are pointed up with the acid of homemade lemon pickles. Then a French chef shows Sara a simple galette of ham and eggs wrapped in pastry - perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Which Came First

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara dives into Chinese heritage at Chinatowns on either side of the continent. In Vancouver, recipes for appetizers cooked with Chinese tea and Dim Sum made by an opera singing Chinese local. Then - a lesson in making Chinese dumplings. Back at home, Wok Queen Grace Young describes her efforts to preserve New York's Chinatown as she and Sara make a BBQ Pork and Yangchow fried rice.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - A Tale Of Two Chinatowns

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara follows a trail in the Mississippi Delta that leads straight to where blues is born. She keeps going to some of the richest farmland on earth where space age tractors bring in the harvest. Here they eat what they grow, and she joins the farmers to make an easy rice casserole and Blackened catfish. Later - the mother of all hometown cookbooks - Charleston Receipts

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's in Barcelona to sip gin and tonics in the shadow of the iconic Sagreda Familia, then joins a food writer to make classic Iberico Pork with Romanesco sauce and Gambas Ajillo. At home, Sara whips up Fideo - Barcelona's take on Paella made with noodles instead of rice.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas

programme.title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang
programme.desc: Cecilia Chiang was born almost 100 years ago in a China that no longer exists. In this episode, viewers get an overview of her amazing story from Beijing to San Francisco.
programme.sub-title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang - A Legend Is Born

programme.title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang
programme.desc: In this episode, Cecilia joins Laurence Jossel, chef and owner of Nopa. Like Cecilia, South African-born Jossel came a long way to open a restaurant in San Francisco. Cecilia shows Laurence how to make "beggar's chicken," a whole, stuffed chicken wrapped in lotus leaves and then clay, and baked for at least two hours.
programme.sub-title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang - The Long Walk

programme.title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang
programme.desc: In this episode, Cecilia teams up with Nancy Oakes, chef/owner of Boulevard, a belle epoque eatery that for the past 20 years has been voted San Francisco's favorite restaurant.
programme.sub-title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang - The Best Chinese Restaurant In America

programme.title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang
programme.desc: In this episode, Cecilia joins Chef Keiko Takahashi, the first Japanese woman in the world to win a Michelin star. She and her husband run Keiko on Nob Hill, a place that feels like a private club, and where the luxurious cooking has a distinct feminine style to it.
programme.sub-title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang - Last Flight Out Of Shanghai

programme.title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang
programme.desc: In this final episode, first they recreate a Mandarin classic dessert, glacéed bananas. Then Belinda does a b.patisserie signature favorite, her now famous chocolate banana almond croissant.
programme.sub-title: The Kitchen Wisdom of Cecilia Chiang - Passing On The Wisdom

programme.title: Martin Yan's China
programme.desc: A vinegar factory is Martin's first stop. Then it's off to Guild Hall Restaurant to cook and eat vinegar inspired food. Next, Martin visits an historic distillery and helps unearth a trove of 50-year old grain alcohol. Recipes: Yin & Yang Ribs, Wine Poached Chicken with Sweet and Sour Candied Nuts

programme.title: Martin Yan's China
programme.desc: In Guangzhou, Martin visits Bai Yuen Mountain and drops by a restaurant at the foot of the mountain that makes the freshest traditional rice noodles as well as an amazing assortment of rice noodle dishes. Afterwards he visits the fish market to explore the variety of seafood the Cantonese crave. Recipes: Crispy Tofu Chow Fun, Honey Salmon

programme.title: Martin Yan's China
programme.desc: Martin reveals how a huge hotel banquet is prepared and then visits the Guangzhou silk market. Later it's a leisurely stroll along a traditional walking street, home to an array of regional shops and wonderful restaurants. Recipes: Jade Lobster, Street Style Crispy Chicken

programme.title: Martin Yan's China
programme.desc: In Shunde, "the Land of Chefs," Martin visits Chef Tan and his environmentally-friendly fish farm. Then it's a cook-off with six award-winning Cantonese chefs each preparing his or her favorite seafood dish. Recipes: Chefs Fish Basket, Seafood Trio in a Treasure Chest with guest Chef Jennifer Cox
programme.sub-title: Martin Yan's China - The Land of Chefs

programme.title: Martin Yan's China
programme.desc: Noodles, noodles, and more noodles are flying around as Martin watches a noodle making performance before dining on some classic Shanxi noodle dishes. Then it's the Snack Forest - a street food paradise where Martin eats silk worms cooked for him on-the-spot and tries even more varieties of noodles. Recipes: Dueling Noodle Basket, Saucy Lamb Sui Mai

programme.title: Martin Yan's China
programme.desc: In Suhe, in Southwestern China, Martin visits the Naxi people. There he savors the traditional food of this ethnic minority group and takes in the spectacular scenery under Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. Recipes: Braised Wild Mushrooms, Red and Gold Fried Rice
programme.sub-title: Martin Yan's China - The Naxi People

programme.title: Martin Yan's China
programme.desc: In the town of Long Jian, Martin sees a traditional Spring Festival parade that is held for the first time in 60 years. He visits the garden of a venerable Feng Shui master, walks through a classic southern Chinese private garden turned into a park and samples milk custard with some young friends. Recipes: Wok Braised Jumbo Shrimp, Golden Comfort Soup
programme.sub-title: Martin Yan's China - Remembering the Past

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's show is a special celebration of Julie's favorite season, Spring! This refreshing time of year puts a smile on Julie's face focusing her cooking on springtime offerings. What better way for Julie to cook, create and celebrate this sensational season than with her crown roasted leg of lamb infused with a bouquet of fresh herbs, slowly roasted, makes the centerpiece on the springtime table!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Spring Sensations

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie makes her Mezze magical in a stunning and scrumptious presentation of her Lebanese cultures most famous small plates perfectly plated for her loving Lebanese family to savor! Mezze, internationally known all over the world as one of the most distinctive and delicious display of dishes to discover originating from Lebanon and Middle East. Julie Taboulie's Mezze makes entertaining enchanting.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Magical Mezze Amidst the Moonlight

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie serves up her street food star supreme sandwich, Shawarma. Succulent, spicy, saucy, shaved off a rotisserie spit, Shawarm is one of Lebanon's most famous street-food stars! Julie shares her special tips, tricks and techniques on how-to make her signature street food star, Shawarma, right at home so you can simply re-create her recipes in your very own kitchen and NO rotisserie spit needed.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Street Food Star, Shawarma

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: An extraordinary eggplant extravaganza Lebanese-style! Julie shares some of her favorite most famous Lebanese eggplant recipes freshly sourced straight from Mama's Glorious Garden. From simple and sophisticated to earthy and exotic, eggplants are excellent selections for sauces, spreads, soups, stews, stuffed and even pickled eggplant too.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Eggplant Extravaganza

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Join the "Queen of Lebanese Cuisine", Julie Taboulie, as she pays a special tribute to her namesake dish and her culinary traditions. Throughout this visually vibrant show, Julie takes viewers back to memory lane of her Lebanese heritage and authentic dishes she grew up eating ever since she was a young girl at her family's Lebanese table. It's tart, it's tangy, it's tasty. It's Julie's Taboulie!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - It's Taboulie Time

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: In this sensational season opener, Julie finds herself in a garden of dreams in Mama's Glorious Garden. Special Mama and garden serves as Julie's number one source of inspiration, ideas influencing her to cook, create and celebrate her impressive line-up of fresh, flavorful, fabulous Lebanese foods. More garden, more glory, most of all more Mama in Julie's garden of dreams, dig into deliciousness!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Garden of Dreams

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: STOP! And, smell the roses with Julie's rose water signature scented sweets hailing from Lebanon and the Middle East. Beautiful and breathtaking rose gardens inspire Julie's baking. Julie's rose water signature sweets will surely have you stopping to smell the roses, inspiring you to create her sweets for yourself right at home as she simply shows you how step-by-step in true Julie Taboulie style.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Stop & Smell The Roses

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's show, a fresh farmer's market is inspiring Julie to make her marvelous Makbouseh, a Lebanese-style summertime squash stew. Julie's Makbouseh, a magnificent medley of fresh vegetables and array of amazing aromatics slowly simmer into a scrumptious squash stew, sure to be a staple at your table. Fresh from the farmer's market to a mouthwatering Lebanese masterpiece you won't want to miss.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Meet Me At The Market

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Dishes include: Tortellini ala Panna, Pasta Alle Vongole All'Esenziale, Chicken Scallopini / Apple Tart.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - To Spoon or not to Spoon

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino explains the difference between Italians from Italy and Italian Americans. Dishes include: Salsiccie al Sugo (sausages braised in tomato sauce ) / Pasta alla Nanci (with Ricotta cheese) / Pasta with Shrimp (Linguine and Shrimp in white wine) / Sicilian Fish Soup / Pannacotta (chocolate pudding with berries and mint).
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Being Italian

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino paints the picture of a life expressing himself through his plating. Dishes include: Red Wine Sauce / Scalloped Potatoes (with Swiss and Parmesan cheese) / Steak au Poivre with Garlic Arugula / Salmon with Brussel Sprouts and Red Wine Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Gardner

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino paints the picture of a life expressing himself through his plating. Dishes include: Red Wine Sauce / Scalloped Potatoes (with Swiss and Parmesan cheese) / Steak au Poivre with Garlic Arugula / Salmon with Brussel Sprouts and Red Wine Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Food Artist

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares how the food he prepares links him to his past, present and future. Dishes include: Salsiccie e Fagioli / Orecchiette Con Broccoli e Salsiccia / Insalata a la Siciliana.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Food Memories

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino explores the history, traditions and uses of the artichoke. Dishes include: Salsiccia Brasate con Carciofi (Braised sausages with Artichokes) / Pasta con Carciofi e Prosciutto Cotto (Pasta with artichokes and cooked ham) / Braised Artichokes and Peppers / Fragole Ubriache (Tipsy Strawberries).
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Heart of the Artichoke

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Nick recounts the first time a group of friends treated him to his first American breakfast and the influence it had on him as a chef. Dishes include: Eggs Benedict "Stellino Style" / Poached Eggs over Chorizo Hash with Tequila Sauce / Chocolate Chip Pancakes.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Breakfast in America

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen

The "not-quite" which has to be seen, is the inventive way the turkey is cut-up before cooking, roasted and re-assembled for serving.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home
programme.desc: "There's nothing as good as a good piece of meat", and as Julia is quick to point out, there is less and less really good (well marbled and aged) beef to be found. Hangar Steak, Skirt Strip, Flank and Ribeye.
programme.sub-title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Beef

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques and Julia create some very special desserts in this colorful episode. Poires Belle Helene - poached pear perched atop pound cake drizzled with chocolate sauce; sweet creamy rich and delicious Strawberries Sabayon; and Crepes Suzette, classically flambéed and served with orange butter and powdered sugar, as well as a Hungarian inspired torta of layered crepes baked with raspberry jam.
programme.sub-title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Desserts

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Salads
programme.desc: Jacques dressed in a toga? For the Julia's Caesar Salad, of course! This show has a salad for everyone, from a simple mixed green salad with a garlic vinaigrette, to classic Caesar and Nicoise (with fresh seared tuna) Salads. How about some Potato Salad? Well, Julia and Jacques prepare two: an American style potato salad with home made mayonnaise, and its tart French cousin.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Sandwiches
programme.desc: As a child, one of Julia's favorite sandwiches was an ice cream sandwich. Jacques was a stick of chocolate between two pieces of bread. Today, Julia's favorite is the Croque Monsieur, or pressed and baked ham & cheese. Of course, Jacques provides a variation he calls a Croque Madam. A close second they can both agree on is the New England lobster roll, served on a toasted hot dog bun.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Vegetables
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques prepare artichokes-several ways-including artichoke hearts stuffed with spinach and mushroom Duxelle. Julia demonstrates her secret to ever-green cooked string beans and butter bruised peas. Jacques counters with his aromatic Tomato Provencal.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Beef Stew
programme.desc: Sounds rather ordinary for this celebrated duet...but here, Jacques and Julia demonstrate why Beef Burgundy and Pot Roast have beens favorite "classic" recipes (here and in France) for what seems like "forever," and they put their own signature on it "Swiss cheese mashed potatoes" (for the Beef Burgundy), and "soft ribbon noodles" (fort the Pot Roast).

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Fish
programme.desc: Sole food and more. One of Julia's most memorable meals was the Sole Meuniere she had on first arriving in Paris after WWII. With Jacques, she recreates this dish, as delightful as ever. The sole is followed by grilled halibut with herbed butter, and poached snapper with beautifully turned and sautéed cucumbers.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Soup
programme.desc: Four classic soups made from scratch in Julia's kitchen: aromatic steaming hot French Onion Soup; Vichyssoise, or chilled Leek and Potato soup, as well as an original variation on the theme using watercress; and a hearty Mediterranean fish stew with an authentic rouille. And, because no show about would be complete without Chicken soup, we are presented chicken & noodle and chicken & rice soups.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Eggs

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Pork

His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: New York executive Paul Racine is on a business trip in Japan when he meets the stunning, enigmatic Kirina. They spend the night together in her hotel room, and Racine returns the next day to retrieve his forgotten keys. But once he's there, he witnesses Kirina's assassination by Kinjo, the leader of a ninja cult. Realizing that Racine has seen everything, Kinjo will do everything in his power to end the executive's life.

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: Joanna Mills (Sarah Michelle Gellar) has a successful career but feels her personal life is spinning out of control. She has few friends, an estranged father (Sam Shepard), and a crazy ex-boyfriend who is stalking her. Joanna begins having terrifying visions of a woman's murder, and it seems that she is the killer's next target. Determined to solve the mystery and escape her apparent fate, Joanna follows her visions to the victim's hometown and finds that some secrets just do not stay buried.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: Wet Hot American Summer
programme.desc: Set on the last day of camp, in the hot summer of 1981, "Wet Hot American Summer" follows a group of counselors who are each trying to complete their unfinished business before the day ends. The entire summer of pent-up sexual frustrations, unresolved post-traumatic stress, pending separations and of course, the talent show, all weigh heavily on the minds and groins of counselors and campers alike.

programme.title: American Pie Presents: Beta House
programme.desc: Freshman Erik Stifler (John White) arrives at college with his longtime friend "Cooze" Coozeman (Jake Siegel). Both freshmen pledge the Beta fraternity and begin a series of often disgusting initiation rituals, climaxing with stealing an object from the house of their rivals, the Geek fraternity. The furious Geek president, Edgar Willis (Tyrone Savage), challenges the Betas to the Greek Games -- a competition that's been banned on campus for 40 years.

programme.title: American Pie Presents: The Book of Love
programme.desc: Three high-school buddies (Bug Hall, Kevin M. Horton) use a legendary sex manual to lose their virginity.

programme.title: Wet Hot American Summer
programme.desc: Set on the last day of camp, in the hot summer of 1981, "Wet Hot American Summer" follows a group of counselors who are each trying to complete their unfinished business before the day ends. The entire summer of pent-up sexual frustrations, unresolved post-traumatic stress, pending separations and of course, the talent show, all weigh heavily on the minds and groins of counselors and campers alike.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Brilliant and obese scientist Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) invents a miraculous weight-loss solution. After a date with chemistry student Carla Purty (Jada Pinkett) goes badly, a depressed Klump tries the solution on himself. Though he instantly loses 250 pounds, the side effects include a second personality: an obnoxiously self-assertive braggart who calls himself Buddy Love. Buddy proves to be more popular than Sherman, but his arrogance and bad behavior quickly spiral out of control.

programme.title: Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Professor Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) is getting married. And the Klump family could not be more delighted. His fiancée Denise (Janet Jackson) is thrilled to become a Klump, and with her appetite she'll fit right in. But Buddy Love ... well, Buddy is another matter.

programme.title: Evan Almighty
programme.desc: Newscaster Evan Baxter (Steve Carell) leaves Buffalo behind when he wins a seat in Congress. Moving his wife (Lauren Graham) and family to northern Virginia, he seems to have it made, then God (Morgan Freeman) throws a crisis of biblical proportions at his feet: The Lord wants him to build an ark and line up all the animals two-by-two in preparation for a flood.

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: As Wendy Darling (Rachel Hurd-Wood) recounts stories to her brothers, John (Harry Newell) and Michael (Freddie Popplewell), she is visited by Peter Pan (Jeremy Sumpter). Peter, a boy who magically never ages, invites Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, an island where he lives with the Lost Boys. Once there, however, Wendy and her brothers are kidnapped by Captain Hook (Jason Isaacs). Peter, with assistance from the fairy Tink (Ludivine Sagnier), must face Hook in order to rescue the Darlings.

programme.title: A Discovery of Witches
programme.desc: Satu brutally tortures Diana in Gerbert's isolated castle ruins; Matthew, now sworn to hunt down and kill anyone who tries to harm Diana, attempts a daring airborne rescue mission with Baldwin in tow.

programme.desc: Diana learns the tragic circumstances surrounding why she was spellbound as a child; Diana's devastation at having lived her life as only half herself is interrupted by the Madison house releasing one of the missing pages from Ashmole 782.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City

programme.title: Athenian Democracy: An Experiment for the Ages

programme.title: Athenian Democracy: An Experiment for the Ages

programme.desc: Relive the decade of perms and shoulder pads! The unmistakable synth pop sound of artists such as Michael Jackson, George Michael, and Whitney Houston is bound to remind you of all your greatest '80s memories!

programme.title: The Dark Alley
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of Thai International Boxing, what starts out as a happy love story between Wong, a champion boxer, and his beloved, develops into a violent and explosive saga of blood and guts. 'The Dark Alley' lights up in a furor of incredible kung fu fighting and ruthless revenge that will leave you breathless'

programme.title: Mighty Four
programme.desc: During the Ming Dynasty, an honest, upright official is murdered by a greedy, jealous and powerful-hungry official, Ma. His son, Chi Liang, vows to someday get revenge and spends all his youth training in the martial arts. But in order to defeat Ma, Chi must master Magic Kicks technique with the help of the daughter of his father's best friend.

programme.title: The Immortal Path
programme.desc: In the Immortal Path: The Tao of Tai Chi Chuan we explore the religious faith of Taoism and the martial art of Tai Chi Chuan. Tai Chi can be called the Tao in motion. The classic Chinese text, Tao Te Ching acts as a guide to the principles of Tai Chi Chuan. As Wudang Taoist master Zhong Yun Long states "The Tao Te Ching tells us that everything in the universe changes and is the balance of Yin and Yang. This is also the heart of Tai Chi Chuan.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: The lone wolf made a promise to a dying undercover Yagyu ninja, to bring his wife to be together with him in the afterlife. This promise led Itto to a village with only women, whose sole purpose is to give birth to new ninjas.
programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 7

programme.title: Kagemusha Oda Nobunaga
programme.desc: As a feared warlord's power grows, so do his enemies. To reduce the risk of assassination, an impersonator is chosen to make appearances, against the warlord's own wishes. The is the story of the "shadow warrior" aka kagemusha.

programme.title: Martial Hero
programme.desc: The story is about a humble man known as the Canton Kid, who just happens to have extraordinary kung fu talent. When the Town Triads team up with a warlord they bring the town to its knees, the Canton kid steps in to restore the peace.

programme.title: Ninja Operation - Knight and Warrior
programme.desc: Alvin, an anti-narcotic agent for Interpol, is on a mission to nail the key man in an international drugs ring. When his wife is murdered Alvin tracks Rudolf to Hong Kong and is sure to look up his long-time friend Gordon, a hard boiled cop who believes in 'an eye for an eye, violence against violence.' Together they combine their expert combat skills to take on the gangs in a bloody showdown.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Tour
programme.desc: Museum founder and president Michael Matsuda provides a detailed tour of the world's first and only Martial Arts History Museum. You will learn about various forms of martial arts, their cultural impact on China, Japan, Korea, Thailand, the Philippines and Hawaii and how Asian history became part of American history. This is a very exciting tour in which you will learn so much about Asian culture and history and the positive influence on Western society.

programme.title: Lady Constables
programme.desc: Two female and one male (the strong, silent type) constables compete to recapture the Night-Shining Pearl, stolen by the Four Chiefs, who are led by the treacherous White Haired General Coldwater Tiger.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: A ronin, a samurai, and ninja randomly cross paths on their travels and get wrapped up in a devious scheme involving a Japanese bath house.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 1

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Retsudo also lost his only remaining student, Sasaka. He lost not only his own son, but also many of his skilled disciples. The "Yagyu sealed letter" was also in Itto's hands. If this code were to be deciphered and revealed to the authorities, Retsudo's position would be in jeopardy, and he would lose his position. It was now a situation in which he had to stand up for himself.
programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 10

programme.title: Layout aka Hero from Shanghai
programme.desc: The place: Shanghai. The time: 1921. The Japanese aggression towards China is getting stronger each day. Enter Hsueh Ao-Lin (Chen Kuan Tai), an agent of the government sent to uncover the Chinese traitors. Once inside, Hsueh must fight both the Japanese and his countrymen for his sake, and the future of China. Shaw Brothers superstar Chen Kuan Tai, plays a classic heroic role, much like his previous films:Boxer from Shantung and Man of Iron. This blood-soaked climax is among his best.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Hai Itto is always a target. Just as he was receiving a request for assassins from Saeki in the precincts of the Ararenji Temple, the Ura Yagyuans, led by Ishine, attacked him with arrows. Itto, who had been cutting down these Yagyuans sent by Yagyu, who were hiding in the form of Unsui, was hit in the chest by an arrow with a poisoned tip, which Ishine had fired. Daigoro tried his best to save Itto, who was still in a coma.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: While continuing on their separate journeys, the Lethal Three run into each other again along with a woman they previously helped. There is something suspicious going on involving a local lord though. Will the ronin, samurai, and ninja get involved to help?
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 2

programme.title: Dragon's Claws
programme.desc: Jimmy Liu, plays the son of the leader of the Dragon Boxing sect, Lung Chen Tien (Liu Ho Nine). An exiled member of the Dragon Boxing sect, Ling Ko Fung (Hwang Jang Lee), arrives in town to claim leadership of the sect by challenging Lung Chen Tien in a duel. The winner of the duel will receive the sacred golden tablet and become sect leader. Lung Chen Tien dies after the match, and then relinquishes the tablet to Ling Ko Fung.

programme.title: High Sky Mission aka American Force 3: High Sky Mission
programme.desc: A group of deadly American commandos led by Colonel Cobra are sent behind enemy lines during the Japanese occupation of the Philippines in World War II. But some of the locals are collaborating with the enemy, so The American Force must tackle rebel guerillas, suicide attacks and booby traps as they carve their path through the jungle in search of the Japanese base of operation.

programme.title: Fearless Kung Fu Elements
programme.desc: According to Chinese legend, the Universe is made of five basic elements: gold, wood, water, fire and earth. These elements are also considered very powerful in kung fu. This film tells the story of five princesses and their loyalty to their clan as each must fight the demon fox using one of the five elements.

programme.title: Kung Fu Executioner
programme.desc: Li, a martial artist, returns home to find out that his father is being harassed by a crime syndicate. Together with an American kung fu champion, he vows revenge when the syndicate kills his father.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema pacta con Aurelio para levantar el negocio y derrotar a sus enemigos, pero pone como condición que Rutila y su hijo vivan con él. Rivero se salva y acusa a Tim de tenderle una trampa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se burla de Tim, y le aclara que ahora no recibe órdenes. Acabará con Meléndez porque ahora es el jefe. Garnica amenaza a Ignacio con las Emes si no lo ayuda a limpiar su expediente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le asegura a Javi que no es un soplón. Tim le pide a Julia que convenza a Meléndez de que no vuelva a México, sin sospechar que Casillas y Víctor van a Washington para eliminarlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica seduce al Tijeras, y ahora es su representante en Michoacán. Tim está desesperado porque no puede ir a Washington, mientras Rutila enfurece a Rivero al contarle que Marcado la violó.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica interrumpe la reunión de los narcotraficantes para proponer ser intermediaria con los colombianos. Los Casillas asesinan a Meléndez, aunque Julia y Tim trataron de impedirlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila se muda con el Chema para estar con su hijo, luego que Aurelio le echa en cara que quedó embarazada para vengarse. Tim le propone a Rivero dar un golpe con la captura de Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica cae de nuevo en los brazos de Aurelio, quien le confiesa que planeó el ataque al rancho para salir de Irma, pero también murió Chabela. Marcado y Garnica le tienden una trampa al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa del ataque de Marcado. Rutila no se salva y paga las consecuencias. A Marcado no le importa nada, y mata a su propia familia frente a los ojos de la hija de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Destrozada, Rutila le cuenta al Chema que Marcado la violó y le echa la culpa. Llama a Aurelio para que la ayude a vengarse, pero Venegas le dice que si habla, no volverá a ver a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con el Chema y le exige que le devuelva a su nieto, mientras Rutila se desahoga con Víctor y le advierte que ahora los dos enfrentan el odio muy de cerca.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim amenaza a Aurelio con detener a su familia, pero los planes de Morejón lo llevan a pactar con él la muerte de su jefe, Jack Meléndez. Rivero desconfía de Rawlings y aún no sabe la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila, angustiada, se refugia en Aurelio y le cuenta que Marcado la violó; él jura vengarse y rescatar a su hijo. Casillas sorprende a Víctor al pedirle ver a Cristina porque se va a entregar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le revela sus secretos a Cristina en una entrevista exclusiva, aunque puede publicarla cuando él diga. Rivero se prepara para capturar a Casillas, pero antes se reúne con Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se enfrenta a balazos con Rivero y las tropas de la Marina, y aprovecha el tiroteo para matar a Espanto. Feyo convence al Chema, y con sus hombres llegan para apoyar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En medio del tiroteo, el Chema le salva la vida a Aurelio, pero le recuerda que tiene en sus manos a su hija y a su nieto. Rivero está al borde de la muerte, mientras don Feyo resulta herido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Antes de su operación, los familiares de Aurelio llegan a Michoacán, donde la Condesa se encarga de atenderlo. Julia termina con Tim, luego que mintió para no implicarlo en la muerte de Jack.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica enfrenta al Tijeras: le tenderá una trampa a Eleazar y a las Emes. Leonor visita a Feyo en su rancho, sin imaginar que ahí están los Casillas. Tim está bajo sospecha por la muerte de Jack.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y la Condesa se besan apasionadamente, mientras Mónica reconoce que ha sido su único amor. Julia le dice la verdad a Leonor sobre el asesinato de Jack. Tim le miente a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le pide perdón a Rutila por dejarla sola con el Chema, y por la muerte de Ximena y Heriberto. Ella descubre que él tuvo relaciones con Leo y jura vengar el asesinato de su hermano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica escucha aterrada que Feyo le pide al médico que deje morir a Aurelio en la operación. Belén niega ser infiel a Aguilera. El Chema está celoso por la relación entre Rutila y Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica llora ante Feyo y le dice que Aurelio es su gran amor, padre de su hijo, y que su relación está mejor que nunca. Ella le salvó la vida a Casillas, ahora él acepta su condición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio sale bien de la operación, mientras Mónica advierte a Belén que se aleje de él porque Feyo los mataría a los dos. Víctor le dice a Robles que negociaron con Javi y los venezolanos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Belén no resiste y hace el amor con Aurelio, mientras Mónica los observa en silencio. Le reclama a los Casillas su negocio con los Soles y la guerrilla. Tijeras está furioso porque no tiene mercancía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica atormenta a Belén porque se entregó a Aurelio, y le sentencia que su calvario apenas comienza. Casillas quiere volver con Robles, mientras el Chema exige a Rutila que seduzca a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se niega a volver con Aurelio, quien confiesa que siente miedo y culpabilidad por la muerte de la esposa de Víctor. Morejón no acepta el ultimátum que los Emes le enviaron con Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Tim arreglan sus cuentas a golpes. Rawlings le propone que se convierta en el mayor lavador de dinero del mundo, y también le pide que elimine al Güero, su obstáculo en la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se reúne en Panamá con Esperanza, su nueva socia, cuya belleza y audacia lo atrapan. El Güero negocia con Tim: le dice que le irá mejor que con Rivero y le pregunta quién es su protegido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cae en los brazos de Esperanza y su amiga. Rivero ordena investigar los negocios de Rutila, mientras ella roba información de su computadora, a pedido del Chema. Omar alerta a Mónica.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Arturo demanda a Dayana, ella cree que su hijo mantuvo relaciones con su propia hermana. Francisco llega a casa de Rosalba por un intercambio estudiantil y ella resulta ser su madre biológica.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paula acusa a su propia madre de darle a su hermana una pastilla para que mejore el rendimiento escolar, pero la niña dio positivo en drogas en un análisis en el colegio porque la pastilla contiene un componente que es considerado como droga. Claudia es hipocondríaca y para cualquier padecimiento consulta al llamado "doctor Google", donde encontró una web de un médico llamado Manuel, pero el hombre no es más que un estafador que solo receta aspirinas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel busca cambiar de género para controlar el impulso de querer tener sexo con niños. Al emborracharse, Jennifer dañó las fotos de la boda de Verónica y, además, arruinó la fiesta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jimena descubre que su papá le dejó una mensualidad de 20 mil dólares al hijo de Daniela, la vecina. Para triunfar en el mundo de la música, Jorge debe vender la casa que heredó de sus padres.
programme.sub-title: El regalo; Entre audición y audición

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bryan, dueño de una compañía de espectáculos de gente obesa, tiene problemas con dos de sus bailarinas porque bajaron de peso. Lisbeth culpa a su hermana por la desaparición de su hijo.
programme.sub-title: Gordura productora de dinero; Hijo desaparecido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Oslenin paga las consecuencias del comportamiento racista y abusador de su hermano Ricardo. Brayan padece de eyaculación precoz, por eso su esposa lo obliga a usar una dolorosa técnica sexual.
programme.sub-title: No hay peor astilla; El pedalazo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gladis acusa a Juan de ser un monstruo porque siendo veterinario, experimentaba con seres humanos. Además, Javier tiene una empresa que se dedica a organizar matrimonios para moribundos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José no va a su boda y le causa un ataque al padre de la novia, ahora quiere destruir unos óvulos congelados. Adriana se entera de que su hijo murió en un accidente, reclama que le hayan mentido.
programme.sub-title: No me muero, no me caso; Mentira por piedad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Candy ofrece alojamiento a cambio de sexo, pero su inquilino quiere terminar el contrato. Su hija adoptiva busca al padre biológico, al reencontrarse, él la viola, embaraza y asesina.
programme.sub-title: Renta por sexo; Me castigaron con sus vidas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Zuky le exige a Johan 30 mil dólares, él la contrató para un video y le mordió una nalga. Un stripper pide indemnización porque en una despedida de soltera le desgarraron los testículos.
programme.sub-title: La dignidad de la gogosera; Testículos desgarrados

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Daniel y Ray nació con problemas motores porque el cordón umbilical se enredó en su cuello y le provocó una falta de oxígeno en el cerebro. Ahora la madre la sobreprotege y el padre quiere que haga una vida normal y se prepare para el futuro. Alejandro quiere desalojar a Débora de la casa de su mamá para venderla y darle la mitad a su hermano, quien fue violentamente golpeado cuando se descubrió que tenía una relación con su padrastro.
programme.sub-title: A la escuela sin autorización; Lobitos con piel de oveja

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nally acusa al guardia de seguridad, Osiris, de haber permitido el crimen de su esposo. Indra fue detenida en su cita de inmigración por portar un arma, ella jura que no sabía que la tenía.
programme.sub-title: Miedo a las balas; Negro complot

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Luis se venga de Rosario quien de joven lo violó con un palo de billar, él le hizo lo mismo. Cinthya denuncia a su cuñado y al padre de este por el abuso continuado y muerte de su hermana.
programme.sub-title: Venganza tardía; Sabías que la mataría y callaste

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Víctor ha estado preso y ahora quiere confesar un crimen, pero su esposa se opone, asegura que él es inocente. Nathalie es perseguida por la mafia rusa porque la confunden con su amiga Valery.
programme.sub-title: Terminando con mi vida; Me ha engañado una escort

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deborah le regala un restaurante a Alejandro y ahora se lo quiere quitar, pero él lo perdió. Además, la hija de Gabriel y Paola es una niña muy delgada, solo come verduras y mira las calorías.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nicolás consume salvia como droga, sus efectos alucinógenos son potentes, su esposa le pide el divorcio. Yohaly y Marianela se disputan 350 mil dólares de herencia, pero no hay testamento.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eduardo tiene hijos, esposa y amante, en una festividad se vieron todos y acabó mal. En otro caso, Carlos y Katiuska descubrieron que Ámbar, la niñera de su hijo, es una ex drogadicta.
programme.sub-title: La comunión del terror; Protección con drogas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Juan lo secuestraron y lo violaron en Cuba. Todos los hechos fueron dirigidos por María, quien descubrió que él es un depredador sexual que persigue a menores y que fue a Cuba para tener sexo con su adolescente hija. Anisley ha despedido de su empresa a Sandro porque ha descubierto que tiene un récord criminal por violencia y, ahora, se siente amenazada porque lo ha visto frente a su casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tiene una hija con leucemia y ella le echa la culpa al padre. Ashley va al restaurante de Carlos con urgencia de ir al baño y al negárselo, no tiene más opción que defecar delante de todos.
programme.sub-title: Con mis mejores amigos; Defecando en el restaurante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luisa casa a su hija discapacitada con Andrés para optar por un tratamiento y ahora que la joven recibe una herencia quiere divorciarlos. Demandan a Jaime por publicar una noticia falsa.
programme.sub-title: El amor no cree en ADN; Falsos culpables

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María contrata a unos actores vestidos de policía para intimidar a su hijo descarriado, pero todo resulta mal. Zoraida se da cuenta de que York finge accidentes para cobrar la indemnización.
programme.sub-title: Ilusiones rentadas; Instinto para dinero fácil

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Cándida le roban el auto en el garaje de la tienda donde trabaja y la despiden, ahora demanda a la exjefa. Javier acusa a Naomi de los destrozos en su casa y la aparición de drogas.
programme.sub-title: El costo del viaje; Locura en casa móvil

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lenin ordena desconectar a su mujer con muerte cerebral y se va a EE.UU., pero ella vive para reclamar lo suyo. Carlos construye una familia virtual y le da más valor que a su familia real.
programme.sub-title: Muerte cerebral; Fantasía de play station

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Detienen a Conni por tráfico de marihuana, su esposo puso la droga en su equipaje y ella no lo sabía. Andrea es un transexual que demanda a Eliza, dueña de un hotel, por discriminación.
programme.sub-title: Contrabando de pasto; Intolerancia a los trans

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raymond es cantante, pero no quiere cumplir su contrato con la productora porque en lugar de promover su música lo usan para vender drogas. Lucí­a dice que no en plena boda y estafa al novio.
programme.sub-title: Mafia en el género; Loca por casarme

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Katherine muere en una celda policial sin agua, comida y sin que nadie lo supiera. El hermano de Scarlett busca ayuda en el restaurante de Jean tras ser herido, pero se la niegan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una señora y su acompañante desaparecieron, le reclaman a las hijas que revelen el paradero. Por una cerca que nadie repone, un petardo impacta a una embarazada y le causa un aborto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Steven sale de Colombia, huye de su familia homofóbica y trae dinero de dudosa procedencia. Por otro lado, Alexa desea morirse porque sufre cáncer de médula y la donante es su mamá.
programme.sub-title: Trampa para deportar; Perdidos en locura

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lleva a una pasajera a la policía, la detienen y pierde la custodia de su criatura. Una pareja busca un donante de semen para tener un hijo, pero ahora una de ellas tiene relaciones con él.
programme.sub-title: La mala intención; Engaño con contrato

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Wilson demanda a Nubia, la esposa de su padre fallecido, por falsificar el testamento: la acusa de asesina. Janet cambia su imagen con las cirugías que paga Abraham, pero él se siente estafado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfredo sufrió un infarto cerebral y tiene distonía muscular. Ahora tiene una novia y quiere independizarse vendiendo la casa que tiene con su hermana para comprarse un apartamento. Magdalena y su pareja graban un vídeo sexual y por descuido termina en las redes.
programme.sub-title: Ladrona de sueños; Expuesta como una cualquiera

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vanessa es taxista y transmite en vivo desde su auto, Luz la demanda por arruinarle la vida al manipular una grabación. Alejandra quiere emanciparse porque su mamá se enamoró de su pareja.
programme.sub-title: Twitch Prime; El novio de mi hija

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deja a sus gemelas con una amiga por 15 días, pero regresa a los dos años. Glenda tiene una productora pornográfica donde los clientes se convierten en actores, una de las esposas la acusa.
programme.sub-title: Volver a ser madre; La caridad del cobre

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The Great Pyramids. The Sphinx. Egypt was a civilization millennia ahead of its time. Were their technological advances the product of human genius or could the Egyptians have had help?

programme.desc: Many people believe we are not alone. But if aliens share this planet, what are their plans for us? We'll unseal the Top 10 Alien Plots and let you know if ET came in peace or if he has something else in mind.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: UFO sightings are a worldwide phenomenon. But for seasoned investigators, ground zero of this explosion was the desert of the American southwest-home to the two greatest UFO hotspots of all time: Roswell, New Mexico and Area 51.

programme.desc: UFO phenomena occur all over the world, from remote places to the skies over the world's major cities. But if aliens are among us then where are they hiding? programme.desc: Is Britain facing an alien invasion? Does it know more than it's saying? And is it really dedicated to protecting its citizens? Or is it only protecting itself. programme.title: The Other Side: Secrets of the Paranormal World

programme.desc: The team explore The Carlton, a location with a dark and mysterious past. programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Deep in the woods on the outskirts of Liverpool lie the crumbling remains of a forgotten gatehouse - and the land surrounding it is said to be cursed. As Sean and Bex begin their nighttime investigation, unsettling activity begins to unfold.

programme.desc: In 1995, a small UK village was disrupted by a brutal fire that destroyed its town hall. To this day, no culprit has emerged - were otherworldly forces responsible?

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: For decades, Kent's Blue Bell Hill has been the site of mysterious phenomena. Rumored ghost sightings have haunted the pastoral site. Explore the haunting legacy of Blue Bell Hill in this episode.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Blue Bell Hill

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Chris Martin is a British man who has spent his life collecting footage of suspected alien sightings. Martin shares his insights on UFO phenomena in this episode.

programme.title: The SS and The Occult
programme.desc: This powerful film revisits the sites most closely associated with Heinrich Himmler and traces the development of his warped ideology. Heinrich Himmler was the creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. He was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past. The occult roots of the Third Reich are discussed.

programme.title: The Real Merlin
programme.desc: His name conjures up images of a golden age of magic, mystery and chivalry. Of Camelot and the search for the Holy Grail, King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table. The Real Merlin finds a sixth-century druid, shaman and right-hand man to the last pagan king, a prophet who predicted his own strange three-fold death.

programme.title: World's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: Bigfoot. Sasquatch. Yeti. Yeren.Yowie. There are reports the world over of these terrifying creatures. This program shows a chilling eyewitness encounter plus scientific analysis of the creature's footprints providing startling insights into this mystery.
programme.sub-title: Bigfoot: Living Creature or Legendary Lie?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard examines the fable of the vampire and investigates the possibility that 'demonically reanimated corpses' may in fact exist. programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Mokele Mbembe means able to stem the flow of rivers. The Pygmies there say they have encountered just such a creature and according to their descriptions, this behemoth is a dead ringer for an Apotosaurus.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard meets the owners of an abnormal humanoid skull allegedly discovered in Mexico in the 1930s and speaks with the researcher who conducted tests on the skull. Is it the skull of a badly deformed child? Is it a hoax? Is it the remains of an extraterrestrial? Is it a human-alien hybrid? A cranio-facial surgeon and a skeptic provide us with their perspectives on this very strange relic.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Florida and San Diego to speak with an acupuncturist and an investigative medical journalist who argue no vaccine has been proven to be safe or effective. An independent investigator believes vaccines are part of the New World Order's depopulation agenda. An author and newspaper columnist argues for the safety and efficacy of vaccines.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to southeast England to investigate a witness to what is described as the best documented sighting of a UFO landing. Richard also goes to Arizona to meet with a witness who shows the contents of his secret journal. programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Mississippi to interview an expedition organizer who plans to lead a team to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world. programme.sub-title: Journey to the Center of the Earth

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: In Dec 1995-Mar 1996, a surge of UFO sightings occurred, notably at Polvorin of As Gándaras, Lugo.
